info.name: TenClothes E-Commerce API
info.description: Postman Collection for TenClothes E-Commerce API (Version 1). Includes Client APIs (Public & Auth) and Admin APIs (Dashboard, Products, Orders, Staffs, etc.) with automated Bearer Token variables storage on login.

item.name: Client
item.description: APIs related to the customer app (Auth, Public Products, Categories, Checkout, Coupons, Cart, Orders, Reviews, and Profiles).

item.name: Cart
item.description: Actions related to shopping cart (validate, sync, add, update, remove)
